description: IOConnex Price Tracker checks live product prices from a product page URL and returns the price, currency, title, and availability, reading the page's structured data. It also builds tagged affiliate links for Amazon and custom programs. No account and no signup required.

defaultPrompt: Check the current price of this product and tell me whether it's in stock: https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/886725
Turn this into an affiliate link with the tag demo-20: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09XS7JWHH
Check the price of the Galaxy S25 Ultra: https://www.samsung.com/us/smartphones/galaxy-s25-ultra/
interface.longDescription: IOConnex Price Tracker checks live product prices from a product page URL and returns the price, currency, title, and availability, reading the page's structured data. It also builds tagged affiliate links for Amazon and custom programs. No account and no signup required.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Two tools: live price checks from product pages (price, currency, title, availability) and affiliate link building for Amazon and custom programs. No account required.

review.commerce_description: Usage is metered per call via x402 micropayments or Stripe checkout; no account required. x402 calls are non-refundable; Stripe purchases carry a 30-day money-back guarantee (full terms at https://prices.ioconnex.dev/legal/refunds).
